{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS175 |prevtitle=The Last Battle IX |nextcode=PS177 |nexttitle=The Last Battle XI |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Last Battle X |title_ja=最終決戦X |title_ro=The Last Battle X |image=PS176.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 176 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 176 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |location=[[Ilex Forest]] }} '''The Last Battle X''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦X''' ''The Last Battle X'') is the 176th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 86th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}}, burrowing underground with {{TP|Blue|Rhydon}} towards the [[Ilex Forest]], recognize the two figures as [[Koga]] and [[Bruno]]. They instinctively battle their two old enemies. Bruno surprises Red when his {{p|Tyrogue}} leaps past [[Vee]] to clear away some rocks. Bruno states that they can use {{m|Rock Smash}} to get to their destination quicker. Koga and Bruno reveal to Red and Blue that, contrary to their belief that they were sent to fight the two [[Pallet Town]] {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, they actually came to help. Bruno also reveals that he saved Koga from the earthquake that hit [[Cerise Island]] a year ago, and the two have trained together ever since. While they help clear away more rocks, both Bruno and Koga thank their former opponents for teaching them how to work for themselves, instead of for other people. Bruno and Koga developed the same viewpoint after meeting each other, and continue to improve each other as well as themselves. They even claim to want to battle Red and Blue again, ideally at the [[Pokémon League]], but due to the event being hijacked by evil forces, they would have to leave it to the boys to take care of things. Koga and Bruno hope that they would eventually meet in a rematch with Blue and Red respectively, after the current enemy is beaten. Just before Koga and Bruno leave Red and Blue, Bruno asks if they have heard of {{adv|Celebi}}. The two boys shake their heads. Bruno claims that Celebi originates from their destination and is said to be able to control time. Red and Blue thus urge Rhydon to hurry, and the Drill Pokémon follows Red's spoon which points towards the surface. Red and Blue resurface right in front of a [[Ilex Forest shrine|shrine]] in the middle of a forest. They hear their [[Pokédex]]es beep, which must mean {{adv|Green}} is nearby. Red reveals that Green had loaned [[Blasty]] to him in order to climb up [[Mt. Silver]] quicker, because the atmosphere became too thin for {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} to fly up. Though Red initially worried about Green as she would lose her means of high-speed flight, Green told Red she would find a way, and Blue understands what she means after looking above to see Green on one of the {{adv|legendary birds}}, facing off against {{adv|Tower duo|Lugia and Ho-Oh}}. ==Major events== * [[Koga]] and [[Bruno]] arrive to help {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}} reach [[Ilex Forest]], which they succeed in doing. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} (flashback) * [[Koga]] * [[Bruno]] * [[Karen]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Espeon}} ([[Vee]]; {{adv|Red}}'s) * {{p|Rhydon}} ({{OP|Blue|Rhydon}}) * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Blasty]]; {{Adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Articuno}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Articuno|Green's}}) * {{p|Zapdos}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Zapdos|Green's}}) * {{p|Moltres}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Moltres|Green's}}) * {{p|Golbat}} ({{OP|Koga|Golbat}}; flashback) * {{p|Muk}} ([[Koga]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Tentacruel}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Onix}} ({{OP|Bruno|Onix}}; flashback) * {{p|Tyrogue}} ([[Bruno]]'s) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Masked Man's}}) * {{p|Lugia}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia|Masked Man's}}) * {{p|Celebi}} ({{adv|Celebi|Adventures}}; silhouette) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|最終決戰 X|The Last Battle X}} (Taiwan)
